title: H2 Analytics deep-dossier refresh

selectedGap.reason: The published H2 Analytics record predates the current amended DND EASE contract, detailed official product workflow and separately documented NRC IRAP live-virtual-constructive simulation integration.

guardrailNotes: This is an additive refresh of an existing published organization. No canonical organization, capability, program, relationship or citation changes occur until a human reviewer accepts and explicitly publishes this candidate.

The public DND contract, NRC contribution and parliamentary testimony establish public activity and context only; they do not establish classified requirements, endorsement or future procurement eligibility.
CAE LinkedIn material is retained solely as discovery provenance for a possible collective-training teaming agreement. It is not field-level evidence in this candidate.

reviewWarnings: CAE's CANSEC 2026 LinkedIn post describes a teaming agreement with H2 Analytics to pursue CAF collective-training opportunities, but no durable CAE or DND announcement was recovered; it remains discovery provenance only.
CanadaBuys confirms the DND award, buyer, procurement method, dates and amended value but does not disclose operational outcomes, end users or classified requirements.
Secondary Ottawa Business Journal performance claims were used only to guide recovery and are not proposed as canonical facts.
candidates.reviewerRationale: H2 Analytics is already published, but the profile can now be made substantially more useful without changing its identity or stable capability ID. Its current official product page documents the EASE workflow from creating exercise entities and AI-enabled intelligence injects through simulation and tracker integration, real-time exercise control and assessment. CanadaBuys records an amended C$1,352,462.75 directed DND software contract for EASE through November 2026, while an NRC IRAP record identifies a C$299,562 contribution to integrate simulation capabilities into EASE for readiness training. The candidate adds only those additive, source-backed updates. It deliberately excludes the CAE LinkedIn teaming claim from canonical data until a durable corporate or government source is available.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: H2's official EASE page supports a workflow that creates exercise entities, generates intelligence traffic with AI-enabled tools, integrates external simulations and trackers, controls exercise flow in real time, and evaluates performance through detailed reports.

CanadaBuys identifies CW2428966 as a directed, non-competitive EASE software contract awarded to H2 Analytics Inc. with DND as buyer, amended to C$1,352,462.75 and scheduled through November 18, 2026.
NRC's public contribution record names H2 Analytics Inc. as the recipient of C$299,562 to integrate simulation capabilities into EASE to improve readiness training under agreement 1019001.

The DND contract record establishes a current EASE award through November 2026; the NRC record separately documents the completed or time-bounded funded LVC-integration effort. The parliamentary testimony provides attributable public context for H2's support of Canadian government and allied customers.
